facts.name: Premium Due Dates Timing
facts.sentence: Subsequent premiums are due on each premium due date according to the selected payment mode.

facts.name: Change in Premium Frequency
facts.sentence: The Policy Owner may request a change in the frequency of premium payments.

facts.name: Change in Payment Method Request
facts.sentence: The Policy Owner may request a change in the method of premium payment.

facts.name: Change in Premium Mode Process
facts.sentence: A change in premium mode requires written notice to the Company.

facts.name: Change in Premium Mode Approval
facts.sentence: A change in premium mode becomes effective upon approval by the Company.

facts.name: Policy Lapse Due to Non-Payment
facts.sentence: Failure to pay the premium by the end of the grace period causes the policy to lapse.

facts.name: Policy Lapse Consequences
facts.sentence: Coverage terminates without value when the policy lapses.

facts.name: Policy Lapse Without Value
facts.sentence: Coverage termination without value occurs except as provided under the Reinstatement provision.

facts.name: No Automatic Premium Loan
facts.sentence: This policy does not include an Automatic Premium Loan provision.

facts.name: APL via Endorsement Only
facts.sentence: An Automatic Premium Loan provision can only be added via endorsement or rider.

facts.name: Automatic Premium Loan Activation
facts.sentence: If an Automatic Premium Loan is in force, unpaid premiums due at the end of the grace period will be paid automatically by a policy loan.

facts.name: Policy Loan Coverage Condition
facts.sentence: Unpaid premiums will be covered by a policy loan only if there is sufficient loan value available.

facts.name: Death Benefit Payout Condition
facts.sentence: The Company will pay the Death Benefit upon receipt of due proof of the Insured’s death while the policy is in force.

facts.name: Death Benefit Payout
facts.sentence: The Death Benefit is paid to the designated Beneficiary.

facts.name: Death Benefit Terms
facts.sentence: The Death Benefit payment is subject to the terms of this policy.

facts.name: Death Benefit Payout Default
facts.sentence: The Death Benefit will be paid in a lump sum unless an alternative settlement option is elected.

facts.name: Alternative Settlement Approval
facts.sentence: An alternative settlement option must be approved by the Company.

facts.name: Proof of Death Requirement
facts.sentence: Proof of the Insured’s death must be provided in a form satisfactory to the Company.

facts.name: Proof of Death Requirements
facts.sentence: Acceptable proof of death includes a certified copy of the death certificate.

facts.name: Additional Documentation Requirement
facts.sentence: Additional documentation may be required by the Company.

facts.name: Additional Documentation Authority
facts.sentence: The additional documentation requirement is based on what the Company may reasonably require.

facts.name: Prompt Death Benefit Payment
facts.sentence: The Company will pay the Death Benefit promptly upon receipt of satisfactory proof of death.

facts.name: Interest on Death Benefit
facts.sentence: Interest accrues on the Death Benefit from the date of death until the date of payment.

facts.name: Legal Interest Requirement
facts.sentence: Interest is required by applicable law.

facts.name: Beneficiary Definition
facts.sentence: The Beneficiary is the person or entity named in the application.

facts.name: Beneficiary Designation Rule
facts.sentence: The Beneficiary is the person or entity named in the most recent written designation on file with the Company.

facts.name: Interest Accrual Post-Death
facts.sentence: Applicable law requires that interest will accrue from the date of death until the date of payment.

facts.name: Beneficiary Identification Rule
facts.sentence: The Beneficiary is the person or entity named in the application or most recent written designation on file with the Company.

facts.name: Death Benefit Payout Priority
facts.sentence: If no Beneficiary survives the Insured, the Death Benefit will be paid to the Policy Owner if the Policy Owner is living.

facts.name: Estate Payout Condition
facts.sentence: If no Beneficiary survives the Insured and the Policy Owner is not living, the Death Benefit will be paid to the Owner’s estate.

facts.name: Policy Owner Changes Beneficiary
facts.sentence: The Policy Owner may change the Beneficiary designation at any time by submitting a written request to the Company.

facts.name: Change Effective on Signature Date
facts.sentence: A change of Beneficiary takes effect as of the date the request is signed.

facts.name: Beneficiary Change Effective Immediately
facts.sentence: A change of Beneficiary takes effect regardless of whether the Insured is alive when the Company receives the request.

facts.name: Change Beneficiary Right
facts.sentence: The Policy Owner may change the Beneficiary at any time during the Insured’s lifetime by submitting a written request to the Company.

facts.name: Change Effective on Signature Date
facts.sentence: A change of Beneficiary takes effect as of the date the request is signed.

facts.name: Beneficiary Change Effective Immediately
facts.sentence: A change of Beneficiary takes effect regardless of whether the Insured is alive when the Company receives the request.

facts.name: Policy Assignment Right
facts.sentence: The Policy Owner may assign this policy or any interest in it by submitting a written assignment acceptable to the Company.

facts.name: Company Liability Limitation
facts.sentence: The Company shall not be responsible for the validity of any assignment.

facts.name: No Tax Responsibility for Assignment
facts.sentence: The Company shall not be responsible for the tax consequences of any assignment.

facts.name: Assignment Terms Binding
facts.sentence: The rights of the Owner and Beneficiary will be subject to the terms of the assignment.

facts.name: Policy Cancellation Right
facts.sentence: The Policy Owner may cancel this policy at any time by submitting a written request.

facts.name: Policy Cancellation Termination
facts.sentence: Upon cancellation, insurance coverage will terminate.

facts.name: Policy Cancellation Effects
facts.sentence: Upon cancellation, no further benefits will be payable.

facts.name: Unearned Premium Refund
facts.sentence: If the policy has any unearned premiums, they will be refunded as specified under applicable law.

facts.name: Policy Copy Access Right
facts.sentence: The Policy Owner has the right to request a copy of the policy.

facts.name: Request Premium History
facts.sentence: The Policy Owner has the right to request premium payment history.

facts.name: Request Beneficiary Info
facts.sentence: The Policy Owner has the right to request beneficiary designations.

facts.name: Request Applicable Riders
facts.sentence: The Policy Owner has the right to request any applicable riders or endorsements.

facts.name: Timely Provision of Policy Info
facts.sentence: The Company will provide the requested information within a reasonable time.

facts.name: Information Access Rights
facts.sentence: The Company will provide the requested information in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.

facts.name: Elect Settlement Options
facts.sentence: The Policy Owner may elect or change the method by which the Death Benefit is paid to the Beneficiary.

facts.name: Settlement Option Approval
facts.sentence: An election or change of settlement option is subject to approval by the Company.

facts.name: Settlement Option Changes
facts.sentence: An election or change of settlement option is subject to the terms of the settlement options offered.

facts.name: Issuing Entity Identification
facts.sentence: Sentinel Life Assurance Company is the issuing entity of the policy.

facts.name: Policy Effective Date
facts.sentence: The policy becomes effective on the date shown in the Schedule of Benefits.

facts.name: First Premium Condition
facts.sentence: The policy becomes effective only if the first premium has been paid.

facts.name: Policy Effective Condition
facts.sentence: The policy becomes effective only if the Insured is alive on the effective date.

facts.name: Policy Form Identifier
facts.sentence: The policy form number is SLAC-TL2025-20YR.

facts.name: State-Specific Provisions
facts.sentence: The policy may include additional state-specific notices or provisions as required by law.

facts.name: Optional Riders Included
facts.sentence: The policy includes optional riders.

facts.name: Accelerated Death Benefit Rider
facts.sentence: One optional rider available is the Accelerated Death Benefit Rider.

facts.name: Accelerated Death Benefit
facts.sentence: The Accelerated Death Benefit Rider allows early payment of a portion of the Death Benefit.

facts.name: Terminal Illness Qualification
facts.sentence: An insured individual qualifies for the accelerated benefit if diagnosed with a terminal illness.

facts.name: Terminal Illness Eligibility
facts.sentence: A diagnosis of terminal illness must come with a life expectancy of 12 months or less.

facts.name: Physician Certification Requirement
facts.sentence: The life expectancy determination must be certified by a licensed physician.

facts.name: Max Payout Limit
facts.sentence: The amount payable under the Accelerated Death Benefit Rider cannot exceed 50% of the policy’s Face Amount.

facts.name: Accelerated Benefit Payment Limit
facts.sentence: The amount payable under the Accelerated Death Benefit Rider is subject to a maximum limit set by the Company.

facts.name: Written Request Requirement
facts.sentence: To receive an accelerated benefit, the Policyowner must submit a written request.

facts.name: Documentation Requirement for Acceleration
facts.sentence: Medical documentation acceptable to the Company must accompany the request.

facts.name: Second Medical Opinion Right
facts.sentence: The Company reserves the right to obtain a second medical opinion at its own expense.

facts.name: Death Benefit Reduction
facts.sentence: If an accelerated benefit is paid, the Death Benefit will be reduced by the amount paid.

facts.name: Admin Charges Reduce Death Benefit
facts.sentence: Administrative charges applied to the accelerated benefit are included in the reduction of the Death Benefit.

facts.name: Interest Reduction on Accelerated Benefit
facts.sentence: Interest applied to the accelerated benefit is included in the reduction of the Death Benefit.

facts.name: Loan Deduction Post-Acceleration
facts.sentence: Outstanding loans on the policy are deducted when calculating the adjusted Death Benefit after acceleration.

facts.name: Liens Deducted Post-Acceleration
facts.sentence: Outstanding liens on the policy are deducted when calculating the adjusted Death Benefit after acceleration.

facts.name: Intentional Injury Exclusion
facts.sentence: No accelerated benefit will be paid if the terminal illness results from intentional self-inflicted injury.

facts.name: Felony Participation Exclusion
facts.sentence: No accelerated benefit will be paid if the terminal illness results from participation in a felony.

facts.name: War-Related Exclusion
facts.sentence: No accelerated benefit will be paid if the terminal illness results from war-related activities.

facts.name: Revocation of Accelerated Benefit Request
facts.sentence: The Policyowner may revoke a request for accelerated benefits at any time prior to payment.

facts.name: Request Revocation Process
facts.sentence: Revocation requires written notice to the Company.

facts.name: CEO of Sentinel Life Assurance Company
facts.sentence: The CEO of Sentinel Life Assurance Company is Eleanor B. Raynor.

facts.name: Chief Executive Officer Role
facts.sentence: Eleanor B. Raynor holds the position of Chief Executive Officer at Sentinel Life Assurance Company.

facts.name: Policy Execution Location
facts.sentence: The policy is executed at the Home Office of Sentinel Life Assurance Company in Hartford, Connecticut.

facts.name: Insurance Fraud Definition
facts.sentence: Filing an insurance application or claim with materially false information constitutes fraud.

facts.name: Fraudulent Concealment Act
facts.sentence: Concealing material facts with intent to mislead constitutes a fraudulent insurance act.

facts.name: Fraudulent Insurance Act Definition
facts.sentence: Knowingly submitting false statements with intent to defraud an insurance company is a fraudulent insurance act.

facts.name: Fraudulent Insurance Act Definition
facts.sentence: Committing a fraudulent insurance act involves knowing falsity or concealment related to material facts.

facts.name: Fraudulent Insurance Act
facts.sentence: A fraudulent insurance act occurred.

facts.name: CEO Role Confirmation
facts.sentence: Eleanor B. Raynor is the Chief Executive Officer.

facts.name: Authorized Representative Status
facts.sentence: Eleanor B. Raynor is an authorized representative.

facts.name: Organization Status
facts.sentence: Sentinel Life Assurance Company is an organization.

facts.name: Eleanor Raynor Represents Company
facts.sentence: Eleanor B. Raynor represents Sentinel Life Assurance Company.
